structure.unit: Highways and Other Surface Transportation Systems
Powers and Duties of Localities; Liability of Commonwealth and Localities

law.text: The governing bodies of counties and cities participating in a transportation district are authorized to appropriate funds for the administrative and other expenses and obligations (i) of the commission of the transportation district, as provided in subsection D of § 33.2-1915, (ii) of an agency, and (iii) for such other purposes as may be specified in a law creating a transportation district.
